name: NVIDIA Parakeet running locally in the browser

mentions.name: NVIDIA Parakeet running locally in the browser
mentions.description: This project runs the NVIDIA Parakeet speech recognition model locally in the browser, implemented with raw WebGPU compute shaders and a SIMD WebAssembly audio frontend. It targets high performance, currently transcribing 1 hour of audio in 20 seconds on an M5 Mac.
mentions.source_excerpt:
NVIDIA Parakeet running locally in the browser. Implemented in raw WebGPU compute shaders & SIMD WebAssembly audio frontend:

https://parakeet.narcotic.sh

The aim is for it to be a high-performance implementation. Can currently transcribe 1 hour of audio in 20 seconds on an M5 Mac.
